stories.title: Grill skill asks a follow-up for vague criteria

fields.summary: As a product strategist, I want the grill skill to ask one follow-up when a criterion is vague, so that every criterion can be observed.
fields.completion_goal: 1. [api-trace] state: the grill prompt for a story over MCP; expected: the question set tells the host to ask one follow-up when an expected outcome names no observable result
fields.scenario: Request the grill story prompt through `aayu mcp` and read its question set.
fields.environment: local checkout with synthetic fixtures; never production

stories.title: Grill TUI re-asks a vague expected outcome

fields.summary: As a human grilling a story on a terminal, I want the interview to ask again when my expected outcome is vague, so that I fix it before review.
fields.completion_goal:
1. [recording] state: the grill story TUI with the expected outcome "works well"; expected: the interview asks a follow-up before the next question
2. [api-trace] state: `aayu grill story` with a draft whose expected outcome is "works well"; expected: the draft is reported with a vague-outcome problem
fields.scenario: Run the TUI with a scripted vague answer, then validate the same draft with flags.
fields.environment: local checkout with synthetic fixtures; never production

fields.summary: As the AI native engineer, I want eval cases with vague answers, so that a skill change that drops follow-ups fails tier 1.
fields.completion_goal: 1. [api-trace] state: tier 1 over evals/cases/grill with a vague-answer case; expected: the case passes only when the recorded run asked a follow-up
fields.scenario: Run `go run ./internal/evals/cmd/eval -tier 1` on the grill cases.
fields.environment: local checkout with synthetic fixtures; never production
